title: Support for Workers Suffering from Workplace-related Mental Health Issues
what_it_is: Support for Workers Suffering from Workplace-related Mental Health Issues

sections.label: Advisory consultation and COVID-19 reference
sections.summary: The Advisory is being consulted on with employers, unions, mental health professionals and civil society groups, while an April Inter-Agency Advisory serves as a reference.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Currently, the Advisory is undergoing consultation with employers, unions, mental health professionals and our civil society groups.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In the meantime, the Inter-Agency Advisory on supporting mental well-being of workers under COVID-19 work arrangements that was published in April serves as a useful reference.

sections.label: Right to disconnect in Tripartite Advisory
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Ministry could include right to disconnect legislation in the Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health to guide workers on talking to employers about non-critical work outside work hours.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: Could the Ministry, therefore, consider incorporating aspects of the right to disconnect legislation as part of the Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health so as to provide our workers with a guideline on how to start a conversation with their employers about commuting outside of work hours for non-critical work?

sections.label: Flexibility, rigidity and Tripartite Advisory
sections.summary: The passage states that relevance or rigidity must be considered given cross-time-zone work and workers who prefer flexibility, and that the Tripartite Advisory has not been announced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The consideration that we must consider is whether something like this would be relevant or rigid in Singapore's context, given the fact that many of us, for example, do work for multinational firms or firms that work across time zones and you need to also pick up calls – and Zoom included – late at night to cater to a different work type of environment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But the same time as well, we also know that enforcing rigidity may also impede on some workers, too, because some prefer the flexibility that they can tend to their kids in the day, run errands, send the kids to pre-school, childcare and then come back, pick up the kids early and then work at night.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, there are different modalities in terms of how we work and intermingle the work boundaries and personal life boundaries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I think these are important points for us to consider and perhaps something that the union could raise as part of our discussions on the Tripartite Advisory.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The Tripartite Advisory has not been announced and I cannot confirm.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
